description: Shell script for configuring and managing Wi-Fi interfaces and hostapd processes on a Raspberry Pi-based device. It gathers interface info, updates configuration files, and controls Wi-Fi security modes and hostapd start/stop procedures.

methods.name: update_wirelessinterface_private_wifi_2G
methods.description: Updates the configuration for private 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi interface by modifying the interface name in the hostapd configuration file.

methods.name: update_wirelessinterface_private_wifi_5G
methods.description: Updates the configuration for private 5 GHz Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: update_wirelessinterface_public_wifi_2G
methods.description: Updates the configuration for public 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: update_wirelessinterface_public_wifi_5G
methods.description: Updates the configuration for public 5 GHz Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: Get_wirelessinterface_private_wifi_2G
methods.description: Retrieves the current private 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi interface configuration and updates it with a new interface name.

methods.name: Get_wirelessinterface_private_wifi_5G
methods.description: Retrieves the current private 5 GHz Wi-Fi interface configuration and updates it.

methods.name: Get_wirelessinterface_public_wifi_2G
methods.description: Retrieves the current public 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi interface configuration and updates it.

methods.name: Get_wirelessinterface_public_wifi_5G
methods.description: Retrieves the current public 5 GHz Wi-Fi interface configuration and updates it.

methods.name: Disabling_XfinityWiFi
methods.description: Disables the specified Wi-Fi interface using hostapd control commands.
